identity.title: Physical conditions in the gas phases of the giant H II region LMC-N 11. II. Origin of [C II] and fraction of CO-dark gas

paper_type_evidence.quote: The detailed analysis of the ALMA map is deferred to a future work.
We observed the giant H ii region N 11 in the Large Magellanic Cloud with SOFIA/GREAT.

question.value: What is the origin of the [C II] 158 um line in LMC-N 11, and what fraction of the molecular gas is CO-dark H2?

evidence.quote: We investigate the origin of [C ii] in order to measure the total molecular gas content, the fraction of CO-dark H$_2$ gas, and how these parameters are impacted by environmental effects such as stellar feedback.

analysis_steps.goal: Compare integrated profiles and test for ionized-gas [C II]

method.value: Gaussian fits to line profiles; line-width, [N II]/[C II] and (CII+OI)/PAH diagnostics

evidence.quote: We can then compare the observed [N ii]/[C ii] ratio to the theoretical value in the ionized gas
For a temperature of $10\,000$ K

Overall, the results obtained with ([C ii]+[O i])/PAH, together with those obtained in Sections [3.2.1](#sec:linewidth) and [3.2.2](#sec:ciiorigin_nii), suggest that most of the [C ii] arises in the neutral gas.

analysis_steps.goal: Bayesian decomposition of CO, [C II], HI profiles

method.value: Simultaneous fit of N components with shared velocity and width, independent intensities, via MCMC

evidence.quote: We use a Bayesian approach with the Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) `PyMC3` code (cite: Salvatier2016a) along with the Metropolis-Hastings sampling algorithm.

key_parameters.value: components 10, 15; min width 1, 2 km/s; min separation 0, 1, 2 km/s

evidence.quote: | Minimum line width ($\sigma_{\rm min}$) | fixed | $1, 2$ km s$^{-1}$ |

assumptions.value: all tracers peak at same velocity per cloud

evidence.quote: all tracers (CO, [C ii], H i) are assumed to peak at the same velocity for any given cloud.

fitting.value: uniform priors on intensity, half-normal on width, half-uniform on separation

evidence.quote: | Line width | free, half-normal | $>\sigma_{\rm min}$ |

validation.value: different input parameters tested; results stable

evidence.quote: We also performed decompositions allowing potentially different line widths for each tracer for any given velocity component, but the main results shown in the following remain unchanged.

analysis_steps.goal: Derive CO-dark H2 with collisional [C II] model

method.value: C+ level populations with H0, H2, e- collisions; atomic [C II] subtracted, remainder attributed to H2

evidence.quote: The \[C ii\] intensity from the molecular gas is inferred from the difference of the estimated \[C ii\] emission in the atomic phase with the observed \[C ii\].
